Welcome to Frodsham Townfield Allotments

A thriving community of gardeners growing together

We Grow Together

We use our plots for vegetable growing, keeping chickens and much more – along the same lines as a traditional allotment. The half plot is ideal for those squeezed for time, while a full plot is manageable for starting out.

The plots are easily accessible in the field at the top of Langdale Way on the junction with Townfield Lane. Grow Your Own is for everyone these days! Nearly 50 plotholders of all ages – from families with young children to pensioners – make this a truly inclusive community.

Frodsham Townfield Allotments are let by Atlantic Hardware. AFTA (The Association of Frodsham Townfield Allotments) provides day-to-day management and works to develop the site and community.

Waiting List CLOSED

We receive an incredible number of enquiries from people hoping to join our community. To manage this, we've decided to close our waiting list to new enquiries for now.

Those already on the list will remain and will be contacted in order when plots become available. We'll announce when we can reopen!
